skill.displayName: OpenSoul - An immutable, private soul for agent Self-reflection, self-improvement and on-chain economic activities.
skill.summary: Enables AI agents to log immutable, encrypted audit trails on Bitcoin SV for persistent memory, self-reflection, and on-chain economic tracking.

latestVersion.changelog:
OpenSoul 1.0.0 initial release

- Introduces an auditable agent identity with transparent structured JSON logging of actions, metrics, and reflections.
- Supports session-based batching and persistent log storage, with tools for log analysis and self-reflection to optimize behavior.
- Provides privacy and on-chain logging options via BSV integration (optional with environment variable).
- Includes setup instructions and example commands for both basic and advanced OpenSoul features.
- Defines standardized log format and actionable reflection guidelines for session oversight and improvement.
